## Is Your Feature Request Related to a Problem?

A clear and concise description of what problem this feature would solve.  
Example: "I'm always frustrated when I can't scan Go source files because the scanner only supports Python."

## Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Alternative Solutions

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

## Which Module Does This Affect?

- [ ] Scanner (crypto usage detection)
- [ ] Risk Engine (risk scoring)
- [ ] Migration Lab (isolated experiment runner)
- [ ] CryptoWatch (advisory monitoring)
- [ ] CBOM Generator (CycloneDX export)
- [ ] AI Assistant
- [ ] Frontend / UI
- [ ] API / Backend
- [ ] CI / Deployment
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other

## Priority

- [ ] Nice to have
- [ ] Important
- [ ] Critical / Blocking

## Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, links to specs, or examples here.
